inlineImageAndParagraph.text:
NMC Verification is the process of confirming whether a medical professional — typically a doctor or physician — is registered with the National Medical Commission (NMC) of India, the statutory body that regulates and maintains standards of medical education and practice under the National Medical Commission Act, 2019. Every qualified medical practitioner in India must hold a valid NMC registration number to practice medicine legally.

Decentro's NMC Verification API enables businesses and healthcare platforms to instantly validate a doctor's credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official NMC registry — returning the practitioner's name, registration number, qualification, and registration status in real time, without any document uploads or manual verification.

inlineImageAndParagraph2.headingLight: What Makes Decentro's NMC Verification API
inlineImageAndParagraph2.text: Decentro's NMC Verification API connects directly to the official National Medical Commission registry to return verified practitioner credentials in under 2 seconds — no document uploads, no OCR, no manual review. Unlike basic verification tools that rely on scraped databases or cached records, our API queries the source registry in real time, returning the doctor's full name, registration number, qualification, date of registration, and current status in a single structured response.

subBanner.text: Decentro's NMC Verification API enables real-time validation of medical practitioners against the National Medical Commission registry, delivering verified results in under 500ms with comprehensive details including registration number, qualification, and practice status.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: NMC Verification is the process of validating a medical practitioner's credentials against the National Medical Commission (formerly MCI) database. It confirms details such as the doctor's registration number, name, qualification, university, registration date, and current practice status to ensure authenticity and regulatory compliance.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Why is NMC Verification important for businesses?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: NMC Verification is critical for healthtech platforms, insurance companies, telemedicine providers, and hospital networks to ensure that only licensed and legitimate medical professionals are onboarded. It helps prevent fraud, ensures regulatory compliance, and builds trust with end consumers who rely on verified healthcare services.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Who can use Decentro's NMC Verification API?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Healthtech startups, telemedicine platforms, insurance providers, hospital management systems, pharmaceutical companies, and any business that needs to verify the credentials of medical practitioners can use Decentro's NMC Verification API to automate and streamline their verification workflows.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How is Decentro's NMC Verification API different from manual verification?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Unlike manual verification, which involves time-consuming searches on the NMC portal and is prone to human error, Decentro's API delivers automated, real-time verification results in milliseconds. It integrates seamlessly into existing workflows via a simple REST API, reducing turnaround time from days to seconds while ensuring accuracy and scalability.
